source: Yahoo Finance chart bars (5m, 60m), regular session

strategies.name: Opening Range Breakout
strategies.description: Long the break of the first 15 minutes' high, on volume, with the market holding its own opening range.

rules.label: Risk no more than 1% of the account

strategies.name: VWAP Reclaim
strategies.description: Midday reclaim (or loss) of VWAP after a flush, either direction, out by the close.

rules.label: Risk no more than 0.75% of the account

strategies.name: Trend Pullback
strategies.description: Buy the first pullback in an established uptrend; hold for days, not hours.

rules.label: Risk no more than 1% of the account

custom_fields.notes_why_entered: AAPL flushed into late morning, then reclaimed VWAP with volume picking up. Entry on the first hold above it.
custom_fields.notes_what_right: Took the stop where the plan said, no hesitation.
custom_fields.notes_what_change: The market wasn't confirming; should have waited for it.

custom_fields.notes_why_entered: META built a tight first 15 minutes on heavy volume. Took the break of the range high with the index holding its own opening range.
custom_fields.notes_what_right: Kept the loss to the planned 1R.
custom_fields.notes_what_change: The market wasn't confirming; should have waited for it.
custom_fields.notes_lessons_learned: A good process still loses sometimes; the size kept it small.

custom_fields.notes_why_entered: MSFT in a clean uptrend, pulled back to the rising 20-day on light volume. Bought the first higher low.
custom_fields.notes_what_right: Sized to the plan and let it work.
custom_fields.notes_what_change: Could have scaled the last third instead of closing it all.

custom_fields.notes_why_entered: Opening drive on AAPL, first pullback held the range midpoint. Entered on the reclaim of the high.
custom_fields.notes_what_right: Waited for the level instead of anticipating it.
custom_fields.notes_what_change: Entry was a little late; the setup was obvious a bar earlier.
custom_fields.notes_lessons_learned: When the setup is clean, the plan does the work.
